formulas.interaction: descriptive equal-weight mean of five call-level component failure rates: non-response, interruption, selectivity, monologue, and validated tool use
formulas.fluency_failure: aligned utterance fails the frozen combined naturalness judge; natural word choice, translationese, and verb morphology are one binary verdict
formulas.speech_fidelity_failure: aligned utterance has any retained fidelity finding with severity >=2 or a tone-meaning-flip failure
formulas.standalone_fidelity_cleanliness: 100 * (1 - delivery utterances with any retained severity >=2 fidelity finding or tone-meaning-flip failure / completed delivery utterances); does not require a Fluency verdict
formulas.experience: 100 * (1 - unique utterances failing fluency OR speech fidelity / utterances successfully evaluated by both)
formulas.gating: only pass/fail verdicts aligned across both judges enter Experience; no-opportunity, deferred, error, and unmatched utterances do not

analysis_unit: 150 canonical domain-task clusters; Experience uses the five localized trial-0 calls for one system because English has no validated fluency judge; Interaction pools five systems per language within each cluster
test: Two-sided paired label-swap permutation; the same swap is applied to the five localized calls in a domain-task cluster, then deduplicated utterance counts are reaggregated into Experience; +1 Monte Carlo correction; Interaction reaggregates component-specific failure and opportunity counts after the same cluster swap; Holm correction is applied separately across ten provider pairs and five language contrasts

reporting_rules.complete_cohort: All 150 calls per language-system cell are retained. Interaction is a descriptive component average over all six languages; utterance Experience uses ES/PT/HI/KO/ZH. Provider and language summaries macro-average language cells. Standalone Speech fidelity uses completed delivery utterances in all six languages.
reporting_rules.utterance_alignment: The structurally injected delivery greeting is excluded, then naturalness and delivery utterances are joined monotonically by strong normalized text prefix. The join must achieve the maximum possible inventory overlap or analysis fails.
reporting_rules.deduplication: Any number of fluency or fidelity findings on one aligned utterance contribute at most one Experience failure.

retired_nativeness_exclusions.rule: Only the enabled combined-naturalness factor enters utterance Experience. Other enabled localization factors remain separate diagnostics; retired rubrics and deterministic checkers remain available but are not scored.

benchmark_transfer_exclusions.rule: The policy-mandated English transfer line is benchmark-authored and not scored as model language.
